origin: recorded 2026-10-30 (RUNNER-RESUME-COST): the pinned CLI against a local stand-in of the Messages API on loopback (fixed answer, 1200 input, 40 output, 500 cache read and 300 cache write tokens per request), its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, no credential and no model call; turn 1 with --session-id, turn 2 with --resume of the same session

files.transcript.jsonl: the session transcript after turn 1 (projects/<folder>/<session>.jsonl), reduced to its user, assistant, last-prompt and cost-state lines; the cost-state line is what turn 2 restored
files.stream_resumed.jsonl: the stream-json output of turn 2 (--resume); the init message reduced to the fields the runner reads

note: Paths replaced by /work; the session reference is invented. The result of the resumed turn counts modelUsage and total_cost_usd for the whole session (turn 1 plus turn 2), while its usage counts turn 2 only.
